Support.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what happened and what you need help with.

Support.emailSupportDesc: Send a detailed request and get a full written response.
Support.faqQuestionOne: How fast do you respond to tickets?
Support.faqAnswerOne: Most tickets are answered within 30 minutes during business hours and usually within a few hours outside standard support windows.
Support.faqQuestionTwo: Do you provide help for billing and invoices?
Support.faqAnswerTwo: Yes. Our billing team can help with invoices, refunds, payment issues, and subscription changes.
Support.faqQuestionThree: Can I contact support by chat?
Support.faqAnswerThree: Yes. Live chat is available for urgent issues and for customers who prefer quick real-time assistance.
Support.faqQuestionFour: Is there documentation for setup and features?
Support.faqAnswerFour: Yes. The knowledge base includes tutorials, setup guides, integrations, and troubleshooting resources.
